items.title: File Widerspruch against rehabilitation rejection
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster-Rentenversicherung Nordwest.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Tuesday 11.03.2025. As a pension fund (social-law body under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), the letter is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 11.03.2025 + 4 days = Saturday 15.03.2025. Unlike tax offices, delivery day for this type of body does NOT move even though it falls on a Saturday. The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after delivery (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: day of delivery not counted) and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 15.04.2025. 15.04.2025 is a Tuesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
